name: delivery
description: Pull-request landing with merge proof and receipts, receipt-driven worktree cleanup, delivery agents and fan-out instructions for OpenCode V2.

agent-plugins.description: Pull-request landing with merge proof and receipts, receipt-driven worktree cleanup, delivery agents and fan-out instructions for OpenCode V2.
agent-plugins.discrepancies: pi (and OMP, which loads the pi bundles) gets delivery_land, an explicit delivery_cleanup for the session's repository and the delivery-git-workflow skill: a merge asks the user first and is refused without a UI, no cleanup runs after a land, and there is no retry or clone registry. The agents and delivery-fan-out are OpenCode only.

prerequisites.for: delivery_land's landing proofs (git merge-tree --write-tree, Git 2.38 or newer) and delivery_cleanup's worktree, ref and remote proofs, git worktree remove and git branch -d
delivery_land's pull-request reads and merge (gh pr view, gh pr merge, gh api) and delivery_cleanup's pull-request read for a GitHub repository
delivery_land's merge-request reads and merge (glab mr view, glab mr merge, glab api) and delivery_cleanup's merge-request read for a GitLab repository
delivery_cleanup's read-only bd show of a receipt's beads when the repository's Beads ledger is active
